question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 9.**
solution:
The correct answer is: earth

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• Water is the clear liquid that falls as rain and is in rivers, seas and lakes.
 
• River is a large, natural flow of water that goes across land and into the sea.
 
• Earth means the surface of the world; land, ground.
 
• Steps mean the action of lifting one foot and putting it down in a different place.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words 'earth' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is, **You only need to remove your shoes and touch the ground with your naked feet and hands.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

Complete Paragraph: *People are tired of staying indoors in artificial lights in view of the pandemic and (1) leading __a sedentary lifestyle. They are yearning to reconnect with__ (2) nature__ and ‘rewilding’ is becoming a key trend in 2021. ‘Rewilding’ is about going __(3) back__ to our ‘caveman/woman’ life by soaking in the sun, __(4) walking__ barefoot on sand and grass, drinking water from natural __(5) streams,__ and bathing in rivers. The __(6) concept __of ‘outdoor living’ is all about spending time in nature, irrespective of the weather, through simple __(7) activities__ that are free of cost, like walking, camping, or fishing with loved ones. ‘Earthing’ is a therapeutic activity, which can be performed __(8) anywhere.__ All you need to do is to take off your shoes and place your bare feet and hands directly on the**__ (9) earth,__** whether it is in a park or at the beach. Another trend is the Japanese way to beat stress – ‘forest-bathing’. You can ‘forest-bathe’ wherever there is an (10)______ of trees, including a nearby park.*
